posts.body:
Start by carefully reading this:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/read-rpg-maker-mz-support-template.163118/

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
This seems like a duplicate post since I seem to recall seeing a similar question somewhere this morning.
Regardless, I will give the same response.
It is highly unlikely that anyone can help you unless you post screen shots or your event showing the entire event window and all pages. We need to see what you actually did to try to see what might be going wrong.
My guess would be that you don't have the Page 2 set to autorun or parallel so it automatically starts when the event switches to Page 2.
But that is only a guess without seeing your event.
